30460.d: Zemouregal's fort is a manor located east of Trollweiss Mountain, and west of the Mahjarrat Ritual Site.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
It can be accessed through the cellar by navigating the Ritual plateau tunnels from the west, during and after The Curse of Arrav quest, or by entering through the front door from the Mahjarrat Ritual Site during and after the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest. 

Alternatively, after the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest, one can reach the fort by teleporting to the Glacor Cave using the fairy ring code DKQ or the Quest Cape and the Master quest cape (option 5), exit the cave to the Mahjarrat Ritual Site, run west to the fort, and use the main door.

30543.d: Zombie hands only appear in the Meiyerditch tunnels.
30543.ex: A giant, zombified hand. I don't think I should offer to shake hands.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• For players who have completed The Branches of Darkmeyer, Drakan's medallion can teleport them to the Meiyerditch labs which connects to the dungeon.
• Using the blood altar teleport to the blood altar.
• Travelling to the Abyss, then to the blood rift and exiting the altar is a quick way to them. To avoid prayer drain, wear a forinthry bracelet or use prayer potions.
• Players with level 65 Agility (this can be boosted) can use an Agility shortcut behind Ivandis Seergaze's tomb.
• Using blood altar Runecrafting Teleport Tablets is faster than using the Abyss and does not drain prayer, and can be obtained as a reward from the Great Orb Project activity.
• The Mask of Broken Fingers or its upgraded version can teleport players directly to the dungeon twice per day.
